plugins.name: code-cinema
plugins.description: Direct and render artistic music videos / short films in code. Analyses your song, then invents a fitting visual style for it; the style library grows with every film. 用代码导演并渲染有艺术性的 MV 与短片：先分析歌，再原创贴合它的画面风格，风格库随每支片子增长。

plugins.name: novel
plugins.description: Write long web serials (100k+ characters) chapter by chapter without losing the thread: layered context loading, continuity log, character state, foreshadowing tracker, beat sheet, and a post-chapter checklist. Tuned for Fanqie Novel. 长篇网文（十万字以上）逐章续写不丢线：分层加载上下文、连贯性日志、角色状态、伏笔追踪、节拍表和写后校验清单；按番茄小说平台的规则调校。

plugins.name: skill-refine
plugins.description: After you edit any skill, consolidate it: file new rules under the right topic, merge duplicates, resolve contradictions, keep SKILL.md lean. Ships a read-only linter and an optional reminder hook. 每次改完 skill 自动做一遍精炼：新规则归到对的主题、合并重复、消除前后冲突、控制篇幅；附只读体检脚本和可选的提醒钩子。

plugins.name: voice-clone
plugins.description: Clone your own voice locally on a Mac (Apple Silicon) with CosyVoice3 and generate Chinese / mixed Chinese-English narration. 在 Mac 本地复刻你自己的声音，生成中文（及中英混合）配音。
